upload_file.description: Upload a file to Replicate and get back a URL you can hand to a model that takes a file input. Better than inlining a large file into every run: upload it once and reuse the URL. Replicate keeps the file for a limited time and reports when in expires_at.
upload_file.name: upload_file

parameters.description: The file to upload: choose one, or pick a file an earlier step produced. Plain text is uploaded as-is.
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: Optional. What to call the file on Replicate. Fills itself in from the file you chose.
parameters.name: filename

parameters.description: Optional. The file's MIME type, e.g. image/png. Worked out from the file you chose when left blank.
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.description: Optional. Name/value pairs of your own to store alongside the file, so a later step can tell what it was for.
parameters.name: metadata

expires_at.description: When Replicate will delete it (ISO 8601). Files are not kept forever.

metadata.description: Whatever metadata was attached at upload time.

name.description: The file name it was stored under.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 checksum of the contents.

url.description: The file's address on the API. Give this to a model that takes a file input.

description: Run any of the thousands of AI models on Replicate (image, video, audio, speech and language) and collect their output. Also covers the account behind them: models and versions, deployments, fine-tuning runs it is watching, uploaded files and collections.
